<b>Dashboard</b> — ekran startowy z pods: Dashboard — the start screen with a numeric summary and activity charts.

<b>Wyszukiwanie</b> to osobny ekran w me: Search is a separate screen in the menu. It answers questions about the structure of the collection: “all orders from 2023”, “applications signed by a particular person”. Chat answers questions about content — the two routes are deliberately not mixed.
<b>Wyszukiwanie</b> — wyszukiwarka po po: Search — the search tool working on descriptive fields.

<b>Zmiana nazwy zmienia tylko etykietę.<: Renaming changes the label only. The internal role code stays the same, so permissions granted earlier and account assignments keep working unchanged.
Administrator widzi wszystkie foldery ni: The administrator sees every folder regardless of the permissions granted. Documents lying in the root folder, outside any folder, are visible only to the administrator — which is why a document uploaded “to the root” will not appear to anyone else, either in search or in chat.
Aplikacja jest narzędziem pomocniczym. O: The application is a supporting tool. A chat answer always points to the source document, and it is the source document that remains binding — for formal matters, go to the document it indicates.
Aplikacja jest rozwijana etapami. Poniżs: The application is being developed in stages. The limitations below are known and scheduled for removal — worth knowing so as not to take them for faults.
Aplikacja odpowiada <b>wyłącznie na pods: The application answers solely on the basis of the documents uploaded. If it finds no information, it says so plainly instead of making things up. An answer of “no information on this subject was found in the documents” is therefore a statement about the document collection, not a fault.
Aplikacja odpowiada na dwa różne rodzaje: The application answers two different kinds of question and has a separate screen for each. AI chat answers questions about content — “from what age of a child is the subsidy available?”. Search answers questions about structure — “show all orders from 2023”. The split is deliberate: thanks to it you never have to guess which box your question belongs in.
Aplikacja odpowiada wyłącznie na podstaw: The application answers solely on the basis of documents uploaded into the base — it knows neither regulations nor knowledge from outside them.
Aplikacja pobiera naraz najwyżej 200 dok: The application fetches at most 200 documents from a folder at a time. When a folder holds more, a red note about it appears under the list — you then need to narrow the search or go into a subfolder. The list never hides documents silently.
Aplikacja przyjmuje formaty PDF, DOCX, O: The application accepts PDF, DOCX, ODT and XLSX formats. Files in other formats must first be saved in one of these.
Aplikacja przyjmuje pliki <b>PDF, DOCX,: The application accepts PDF, DOCX, ODT and XLSX files, each up to 100 MB in size. The list of formats is visible in the upload window and comes straight from the application settings — if the administrator changes it, the window will show the new list and the system file picker will filter out the remaining extensions.
The application signed me out by itself.
Aplikację otwieramy w przeglądarce inter: You open the application in a web browser at the address given by your administrator. Above the form is the instance mark — an icon and a name. You sign in with your e-mail address and the password received from the administrator; capitalisation in the address does not matter.
Brak linijki z porównaniem nie oznacza u: A missing comparison line does not mean a fault. The application does not show a percentage change when the previous period was too thin for a percentage to mean anything — growth “of 400%” from one document to five is a true and useless number.
Cała aplikacja wraz z modelem językowym: The whole application, language model included, runs on a server belonging to ⟦WLASCICIEL⟧. Neither the content of the documents nor the questions asked ever leave that server, and nothing is sent to any external service. Access to documents follows from the permissions granted to the role an account belongs to — a user sees only the folders shared with them.

Grupa uprawnień przypisana kontu — to ro: A group of permissions assigned to an account — folders are shared with roles, not with people.

Ikona kosza usuwa dokument wraz z jego f: The bin icon deletes a document together with its passages in the knowledge base — once deleted, it stops appearing in chat answers. Deleting a folder moves its documents to the root folder, so nothing is lost along with the folder.

Kafelek <b>Potrzebujesz pomocy?</b> na d: The Need help? tile at the bottom of the side menu leads to the technical support request form. Kategoria rozpoznana automatycznie: zarz: A category recognised automatically: order, procedure, application form and others.
Kawałek dokumentu, na jakie aplikacja dz: A piece of a document — the units the application splits content into so that it can point precisely to the source of an answer.
Każda rozmowa zapisuje się na liście po: Every conversation is saved in the list on the left and you can return to it. The New chat button starts a conversation from scratch. This matters: within a single conversation the application takes earlier questions into account, so when the subject changes it is better to start a new one.
Każda zmiana jest opisywana w <b>Histori: Every change is described in the Change history available from within the application, from under the version number at the bottom of the menu.
Każde pole ma typ: <b>Tekst</b>, <b>Data: Every field has a type: Text, Date, Number, Amount or Value list. The type is not decoration — it decides what you can do with the field. Dates allow filtering by ranges, and amounts go into the spreadsheet as numbers with decimals, so the column adds up (even when the document wrote it as “1,234.56 PLN”).
Każdy dokument przechodzi automatyczne p: Every document goes through automatic processing. The application reads its content (tables included), splits it into passages, recognises the kind of document — an order, a procedure, an application form — and extracts descriptive fields from it, for example a number, a date or the approving person. Only then does the document become visible to search and to chat.
Każdy rodzaj dokumentu może mieć <b>wzor: Every kind of document may have a file-name pattern, for example {type}-no-{document_number}-{date}. Kliknięcie w znak instancji na szczycie: Clicking the instance mark at the top of the menu collapses it to icons only, leaving more room for content. Clicking again expands it. The choice is remembered between sessions, so a menu collapsed once stays collapsed after the next sign-in too.
Kliknięcie wiersza otwiera okno ze szcze: Clicking a row opens a window with the details: file type, size, processing status, date added, folder, the account that uploaded the document and the recognised category. Kolejka plików pokazuje, jakie pola udał: The file queue shows which fields were extracted from each document. If a field is empty for many documents of the same kind, it is usually worth correcting the classification criteria or the field name in the schema.
Kolejka plików — statusy, rozpoznane rod: The file queue — statuses, recognised kinds and document fields.
Konta osób, które odeszły, dezaktywować: Deactivate rather than delete the accounts of people who have left — this preserves the history of operations.
Konto ma rolę, ale rola nie ma jeszcze u: The account has a role, but the role does not yet have permissions to any folder. Permissions are granted in the Files view, with the key icon beside a folder.

Lista plików pokazuje typ pliku, nazwę,: The file list shows the file type, name, size, the category recognised by the application and the date added. Po okresie bezczynności aplikacja wylogo: After a period of inactivity the application signs you out automatically — a safeguard in case a session is left open on a shared computer. The administrator sets the length of that period; regardless of it, a session has a hard limit of twelve hours.

Each entry gives the reference number, file type, document category, page and file name; clicking it opens the source document. Pole <b>Szukaj pliku</b> nad listą filtr: The Search files box above the list filters documents by name within the current folder. Under the list is the number of documents and a choice of how many entries to show per page (10, 25, 50 or 100).

At the top of the page there are two buttons: Open in a new tab and Download PDF. Pytania „o to samo innymi słowami” bywaj: Questions asking “the same thing in other words” are often effective. If the first answer is general, it is worth asking about a detail — the application then searches within the documents indicated in the previous answer.

Role definiuje się na ekranie <b>Lista d: Roles are defined on the Access list screen with the Add role button. A role can also be renamed and deleted. Three rules the application enforces are worth knowing:
Roli ani statusu konta nie zmienia się s: You do not change your own role or account status — the administrator does. If the e-mail address or name you enter is already taken by another account, the application says so plainly and does not save the change.

Uprawnienie nadane folderowi obejmuje <b: A permission granted on a folder covers its subfolders as well. In the permissions window, inherited entries are described as (inherited from parent) and cannot be removed there — they are changed on the parent folder. On a subfolder, access can only be widened, for example Read raised to Write.
Usunięcia dokumentu nie da się cofnąć z: Deleting a document cannot be undone from within the application. Before deleting a larger batch it is worth downloading a summary of the documents to a spreadsheet — the Download this list as XLSX button on the Search screen does exactly that.
W Kolejce plików można ręcznie wskazać w: In the File queue you can point to the right kind by hand; the application will immediately extract the fields anew.
W katalogu głównym zwykłe konto nie widz: In the root folder an ordinary account sees no files — documents lying outside folders are available to the administrator only. What is visible instead are the folders shared with our role.
W wierszu <b>Parser</b> widać, czy model: The Parser row shows whether the language model is busy at that moment. “Model idle” means a new question or document will be handled straight away; when the model is computing, a chat answer may have to wait a while.
Warto napisać, <b>co się robiło</b> i <b: It is worth writing what you were doing and what you expected, not just “it does not work”. The name of the screen, the wording of the question put to the chat or the name of the document shortens the diagnosis by several exchanges of messages.

Zarówno foldery, jak i pliki można ogląd: Both folders and files can be viewed as a list or as tiles — the switch sits in the header of each card, and the choice is independent for folders and for files. Zaznaczenie dokumentów polami wyboru po: Selecting documents with the checkboxes on the left reveals the Act on selected button with two options: Move to another folder and Rename to match category (described in the chapter on document recognition). Zestawienie uprawnień wszystkich ról ora: A summary of the permissions of all roles together with the management of the roles themselves — described in the chapter on permissions.
Zgłoszenie idzie <b>pocztą, a nie przez: The request goes by mail, not through the document processing mechanism. This is deliberate: a processing failure must not cut off the route for reporting a problem, because that is exactly when reports are needed most.

⟦PELNA⟧ (w skrócie <b>⟦NAZWA⟧</b>) to we: ⟦PELNA⟧ (⟦NAZWA⟧ for short) is an internal document repository. The application does two things at once: it keeps documents in an orderly folder structure and lets you ask questions about their content in plain language, the way you would ask a colleague who knows those documents.
